description_en: Stops Serverless jobs in a cluster based on job IDs or subtask IDs (array jobs). If you specify the job ID of an array job, all subtasks in the job are stopped
description_zh: 按照作业ID或子任务ID（数组作业）停止集群中一个或多个Serverless作业。当传入数组作业的作业ID时，会停止该作业下的所有子任务
name: StopServerlessJobs

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the E-HPC cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The serverless job IDs or subtask IDs (array jobs).

If you specify the job ID of an array job, all subtasks under the array job are stopped.
If you specify the ID of a subtask of an array job, only the subtask is stopped
parameters.help_zh:
Serverless作业ID或子任务ID（数组作业）列表。
当传入数组作业的作业ID时，会停止该数组作业下的所有子任务。
当传入数组作业下的子任务ID时，仅停止该子任务
parameters.name: job_ids
